games.title: Casino
games.subtitle: Classic Dominican Casino
games.description: Capture cards from the table that match the value of the card you play. Special cards earn extra points. First player to 21 wins. About 10–12 minutes · 2 players.

games.title: Casino Speed
games.subtitle: One-round Casino
games.description: Same Casino capture rules, decided in a single round. Highest score wins; coin awards break ties; still tied means another round. About 2–5 minutes · 2 players.

games.title: Tres y Dos
games.subtitle: Form a 3 and a 2 of matching ranks
games.description: Form a set of 3 and a set of 2 of the same card ranks before the other players do. Win 3 rounds to take the match. About 5–7 minutes · 2–4 players.
rules: Win 3 rounds to win the match

games.title: Robaito
games.subtitle: Steal stacks and dominate the table
games.description: Capture cards from the table and steal from other players' stacks. The player with the most cards at the end wins!
